command:
cd /home/runner/work/boo4blue.github.io/boo4blue.github.io/cloud-pc/storage
mkdir -p rvc-training
cd rvc-training
LOG="../rvc-training.log"
echo "=== RVC Naruto Training Setup - $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG"
START=$(date +%s)
echo "[1/6] Downloading reference audio..." | tee -a "$LOG"
curl -L --retry 3 "https://muse.ai/files/1400300103161982/872612365880023/0j0u8ozreyguhfkidwxxav2p/naruto-mega-ref.flac" -o naruto-mega-ref.flac 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
ls -lh naruto-mega-ref.flac | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[2/6] Installing Python dependencies..." | tee -a "$LOG"
pip install --quiet torch torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 2>&1 | tail -2 | tee -a "$LOG"
pip install --quiet numpy scipy librosa soundfile 2>&1 | tail -2 | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[3/6] Cloning RVC repository..." | tee -a "$LOG"
if [ ! -d "Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI" ]; then git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI.git 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; fi
cd Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI
echo "[4/6] Downloading pretrained models..." | tee -a "$LOG"
mkdir -p assets/hubert assets/pretrained
if [ ! -f "assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt" ]; then curl -L --retry 3 "https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/hubert_base.pt" -o assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; fi
if [ ! -f "assets/pretrained/f0G40k.pth" ]; then curl -L --retry 3 "https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/pretrained/f0G40k.pth" -o assets/pretrained/f0G40k.pth 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; fi
if [ ! -f "assets/pretrained/f0D40k.pth" ]; then curl -L --retry 3 "https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/pretrained/f0D40k.pth" -o assets/pretrained/f0D40k.pth 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; fi
ls -lh assets/hubert/ assets/pretrained/ | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[5/6] Converting audio to RVC format..." | tee -a "$LOG"
mkdir -p dataset/naruto-en
ffmpeg -v error -y -i ../naruto-mega-ref.flac -ac 1 -ar 40000 dataset/naruto-en/naruto-ref.wav 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
ls -lh dataset/naruto-en/ | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "[6/6] Verifying setup..." | tee -a "$LOG"
python3 -c "import torch; print('torch:', torch.__version__); import os; sz=os.path.getsize('assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt'); print(f'hubert: {sz/1e6:.0f}MB'); assert sz>300e6; print('SETUP OK')" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "=== Setup complete in $(( $(date +%s) - START ))s ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
